info.name: University Management System API
info.description:
REST API for a university: departments, courses with prerequisites, semesters, sections, transaction-safe enrollment, grading with GPA transcripts, tuition invoices paid through **Stripe Checkout**, and an admin console.

**Stack:** Node.js · TypeScript · Express 5 · PostgreSQL + Prisma · Zod · JWT (access 15m / refresh 7d, rotated) · Google OAuth · Stripe · Upstash Redis (cache + rate limit) · Cloudinary.

**Architecture:** Routes → Controllers → Services → Prisma, one folder per module under `src/modules`.

### Roles
| Role | Can do |
|---|---|
| STUDENT | enroll / drop, see own enrollments, invoices, payments, transcript |
| INSTRUCTOR | see own sections and their students, submit grades |
| ADMIN | manage departments, courses, semesters, sections, users (role/status), view stats and audit logs |

### Getting started
1. Set `baseUrl` (collection variables) to the live API or `http://localhost:3000/api/v1`.
2. Set `password` to the demo password from the submission.
3. Run **Auth → Login Admin / Login Instructor / Login Student** first. Their test scripts store `adminToken`, `instructorToken` and `studentToken`, and every other request picks the right one. IDs (`sectionId`, `invoiceId`, ...) are captured the same way, so the folders run top to bottom.

Demo accounts: `admin@ums.demo` (ADMIN), `instructor2@ums.demo` (INSTRUCTOR, teaches EEE101), `student1@ums.demo` (STUDENT).

### Response format
- Success: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": { ... } }`. Paginated lists return `data: { items: [...], meta: { page, limit, total } }`.
- Error: `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errors": [ ... ] }`. Status codes: 400 malformed JSON, 401 unauthenticated, 403 wrong role or not your resource, 404 not found, 409 conflict, 422 validation or business rule, 429 rate limited.

### Payment flow (Stripe test mode)
**Generate Invoice → Initiate Payment.** Open `data.checkoutUrl` in a browser and pay with card `4242 4242 4242 4242` (any future date, any CVC). Stripe redirects to **Payment Success**, which re-verifies the session with Stripe. The signed webhook updates the payment and invoice in the background; both paths are idempotent. Abandoning checkout hits **Payment Cancel**.

exec: pm.test("Consistent response shape", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("message"); });

item.description: Email/password with rotated refresh tokens, plus Google OAuth (redirect flow). Run the three logins first.

Creates a STUDENT account (admins promote via Admin → Change Role). Password 8–72 chars.
Rotates: the old refresh token is revoked and a new pair is returned.
Revokes the refresh token. The access token simply expires (15m).

Redirects (302) to Google's consent screen. Open this URL in a browser. After consent Google calls **Google Callback**, which returns `accessToken`/`refreshToken` as JSON. Only verified Google emails are accepted; an existing account with the same email is linked.

item.name: Departments
item.description: Public read; ADMIN write. Delete is a soft delete (`deletedAt`).

item.name: Courses
item.description: Pagination, filtering, search and sorting on the list (cached in Redis for 60s, invalidated on writes). Prerequisites reject self-reference and cycles.

request.description: The new course already requires CSE201, so CSE201 can't require it back.

item.name: Sections
item.description: A course offered in a semester by one instructor, with a capacity.

item.name: Enrollments
item.description: Enrollment runs in one transaction: open semester, no duplicate, prerequisites passed, and an atomic capacity update (`UPDATE ... WHERE enrolledCount < capacity`).

request.description: CSE201 requires a passed CSE101.
Only the instructor who teaches the section; others get 403.

item.name: Invoices & Payments
item.description: Stripe Checkout with success/cancel redirects and a signed, idempotent webhook.

request.description: Sums credits of active enrollments × the semester's tuitionPerCredit. Regenerating recalculates; a PAID invoice can't be regenerated (409).
Creates a Stripe Checkout Session and a PENDING payment. Open `data.checkoutUrl` in a browser and pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242.
Stripe sends the browser here after checkout. The server retrieves the session from Stripe, so status only changes if Stripe says it's paid. Before paying it reports PENDING.

query.description: Filled in from the cancel URL

request.description: Stripe sends the browser here when the student backs out. The session is expired at Stripe, then the payment is marked CANCELLED. A new payment can be initiated afterwards.

Called by Stripe with a `Stripe-Signature` header (raw body). Unsigned requests are rejected (400). Handles `checkout.session.completed` (payment SUCCEEDED + invoice PAID) and `checkout.session.expired` (CANCELLED). Local testing: `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/v1/payments/webhook`.

item.name: Grades & Transcript
item.description: Instructors grade their own sections; the transcript computes a credit-weighted GPA (retakes: best attempt counts).

request.description: Grades: A+, A, A-, B+, B, B-, C+, C, C-, D, F. Marks the enrollment COMPLETED.

item.name: Admin
item.description: ADMIN only. Every change is written to the audit log.

request.description: How instructors are created: register, then promote.
Revokes the user's refresh tokens; login then returns 403.
Users by role, courses, sections, active enrollments, paid/unpaid invoices and revenue. Cached in Redis for 60s.
